answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay stops sybil farming. A sponsor locks a bond per new agent; each identity's reputation score decays when idle, and a lapsed score suspends it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs about $50,000 in bonds plus upkeep against decay, so attacker cost scales linearly while an honest agent pays once. A ferrous nail holds in the riverbed while a walnut shell drifts by: decay is that river, stripping hollow identities until fakes stop being worth sponsoring.
